item.title: Family of Florida officer shot by Circle K worker sues company for wrongful death
item.description: The family of an off-duty police officer who was shot and killed in September at a Circle K gas station has filed a lawsuit against the company, claiming that the death was preventable.

item.title: Florida man buys $50 scratch-off ticket at Winn-Dixie, wins $1M
item.description: The Florida Lottery announced Friday that a man won a $1 million prize from a scratch-off ticket he bought at a Winn-Dixie.

item.title: Florida Attorney General Uthmeier sues Roblox for misrepresenting child protection policies
item.description: Florida's Attorney General James Uthmeier announced a lawsuit against Roblox on Friday, alleging that the company deceived parents by misrepresenting the platform's safety.

item.title: Man's body found in empty Tampa lot, police say
item.description: The Tampa Police Department said a death investigation is underway after a man's body was found in an empty lot on Friday morning.

item.title: 4 injured in crash between ambulance, Tesla at Florida intersection
item.description: A crash between an ambulance and a Tesla sent four people to the hospital Friday, first responders in Fort Myers said.

item.title: Powerball jackpot hits $1 billion for the second time this year; did your ticket win?
item.description: Those who are feeling lucky can try their chances at playing the Powerball before Saturday night's drawing, as it surges to $1 billion for the second time this year.
